Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Kavya Patel. I am a 52-year-old college lecturer living in Bengaluru. Harish Swamy gave me a cheque for 20.1 lakh rupees to repay a loan, but the cheque was dishonoured because the signature did not match. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 08612468933 or email kavya.patel@example.com.
